working_definition: Author type 'T4c' of the Özel et al. 2021 optic lobe atlas (Supplementary Table 1).

best_match.fbbt_definition: T4 neuron with its lobula plate arbor in layer 3 (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989). It responds to motion in an upwards direction (Henning et al., 2022).

justification: 'T4c' is the exact label or an exact synonym of FBbt:00003734 'T4c neuron'.
